title: China, Japan hold talks to tone down tensions over PM Takaichi's remarks on Taiwan
description: BEIJING, Nov 18: Officials from China and Japan on Tuesday held talks in Beijing to tone down tensions over Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s recent remarks on Taiwan, which led to a sharp deterioration in bilateral ties. Liu Jinsong, Director General of the Department of Asian Affairs of the Chinese Foreign Ministry, held consultations with Kanai Masaaki, Director-General of the Japanese Foreign Ministry’s Asian and Oceanian Affairs Bureau, Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning told the media.
